plugins.name: bite
plugins.description: Native Apple apps for agents: 38 MCP tools over Calendar, Reminders, Mail, Notes, Contacts and Messages. Rust control plane + native Swift EventKit/ScriptingBridge helper. Requires `bite` on PATH (cargo install bite-mcp).
